notes.title: 💋 The New Bored Wife Update Is Live! 💋
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052130/318461336c5ee0d8d3d5c8c839ce2a855f1f1a4f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]She’s back — with a brand-new update that brings more story, more spice, and a major visual upgrade 🔥[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052130/159f0fe0b90ed41816d4bd226b238d90b35b7f85.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’ve been working hard behind the scenes to deliver our biggest update yet, and it’s finally ready for you to enjoy. Whether you’re here for the plot (👀) or the steamy scenes, this release has something you’ll love.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052130/b611deeb1fa5edada58d0b86c0b66de179fd6678.jpg"][/img][/p][p]🆕 What’s New:[/p][list][*][p]✨ 500+ new renders — with updated lighting and sharper detail[/p][/*][*][p]🎞️ 15 brand-new animations — smoother, hotter, and more expressive[/p][/*][*][p]🏆 5 new achievements — unlock them all[/p][/*][*][p]🎙️ Voice acting — bringing key scenes to life[/p][/*][*][p]🎵 Background music — setting the tone for every moment[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ Visual overhaul — thanks to a reworked rendering pipeline, the whole game looks better than ever[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052130/495e330d7b80699b5967ae5d174ced3f1ec4555c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’ve taken a big step forward with how Bored Wife looks and feels. The new rendering system took time to implement, but the result is a richer, more polished experience across the board.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052130/f7e6ceb859fc6cab87ace8c62f73eaf9770bda7e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This update is about more than just visuals — it’s about pushing the story forward and deepening the emotional (and physical 😏) journey of our characters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052130/6d3e15d1185de2ffa630727410d9b721340c0c00.gif"][/img][/p][p]We truly hope you enjoy this release — and as always, thank you for playing and supporting Bored Wife! 💖[/p]

notes.title: 💋 Upcoming Update — Coming Very Soon! 💋
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]A brand new Bored Wife update is just around the corner — and it’s our biggest one yet! 🔥[/p][p]Here’s what’s coming in the next release:[/p][p]✨ 500+ new renders[/p][p]🎞️ 15 fresh animations[/p][p]🏆 5 new achievements[/p][p]🎙️ Voice acting[/p][p]🎵 Background music[/p][p]🛠️ Improved visual quality thanks to a reworked rendering pipeline[/p][p]We’ve poured a ton of effort into this update — more story, more heat, and an even better visual experience. We can’t wait for you to see it![/p][p]Stay tuned — it’s almost here 💖[/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting Bored Wife![/p]
